It includes diagrams showing the sub-screen feature, where a fisheye image is displayed as a sub-screen in the upper left corner, and instructions on how to toggle between this view and the full display. Additionally, it explains the "Partial expansion + 360° panorama" display feature, which allows users to view a partially expanded video and a 360-degree panorama simultaneously, with instructions on how to switch between these views using the Shift key and Home button.

The manual further describes the difference in recorded still images depending on the saving method, showing examples of a fisheye view and a dewarped image.
